notes.title: THE NEW GAME BY CKOLMOS NARRATIVE
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=7FOPjLvfHQ0;full][/previewyoutube]

WISHLIST NOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2330030/The_Murder_of_Sherlock_Holmes/

The Murder of Sherlock Holmes combines the fascinating genre of Escape Rooms with the total immersion in first-person virtual reality. With a unique Voxel Art artistic style, players will be transported to the vibrant universe of Oniria, where every detail comes to life. Find the murderer of this famous character by investigating his own house. The immersion of virtual reality and the challenges of the escape room offer a unique gaming experience.

The game detects the "OK" signal with the hand.

One of the standout features of this game is its exceptional attention to realism in control. Through the innovative use of hand gesture detection system, players can manipulate their virtual environment naturally and immersively. From opening books to solving puzzles, the tactile experience is incomparable. The game also captures the "OK" signal with the hand, avoiding the need for the player to press buttons. This gave the studio the Most Innovative Video Game Award in 2023. The combination of all this results in a fluid and surprising interaction.

Every corner of 221B Baker Street is meticulously designed and full of secrets to discover. Players will be immersed in a captivating narrative as they explore Sherlock Holmes' residence in search of clues to solve the mystery. Almost every object is interactive, and each book contains information about the Oniria universe and Holmes.

With this game, virtual reality reaches a new level, offering, not only an exciting story, but also unprecedented interaction and immersion that will leave players amazed.
Do you have what it takes to solve the mystery and find the killer of the world's most famous detective? 

Find it out in The Murder of Sherlock Holmes.

notes.title: The new era of DREAMING is here
notes.notes:
[b]Dear players[/b], 

The last few months have been very difficult for us. After disagreements with our publisher, we have decided to continue self-publishing Oniria Crimes, but to this day,[b] console versions are still published on some platforms and are out of our control[/b] (Check [url=https://oniria.world/en/2022/06/21/oniria-crimes-will-no-longer-be-available-in-console-online-stores/]Oniria Crimes will no longer be avaiable in console online stores[/url] for more info).

We wanted to release this new patch as a thank you for the support you give to a small indie team like us. We will continue to improve [b]Oniria Crimes[/b] as long as you keep asking us for changes. In the coming months [b]we are going to release a new patch and a free DLC with new content[/b]. Oniria Crimes has 100% positive reviews in Steam (Even if we need much more!), and we want to reach players who love reading and dreaming. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38266521/31219f233c75684a910e32a3a8d0d451f759236b.jpg[/img]

It is a difficult challenge, but [b]we are not alone: ​​we count on your help[/b].

For now, we bring you patch 1.14 with the following improvements:

- Puzzle in case 4 was rebuild to adapt to the new url in oniria.world domain
- Some localization problems was fixed in English and Spanish
- Trailer and credits were modified to put cKolmos narrative as publisher
- Some minor bugs were fixed also

[previewyoutube=JijMMFUK5jE;full][/previewyoutube]

What we didn't patch:
- Sound and audio will be revised in the next patch, and other bugs reported also.
- The gun in case 6 speaks Italian. This is not a localization mistake. She is italian. What she sais is just a joke, is not important for the case.
- You can skip cutscenes with ESC. We don't like the idea of skipping with any key because you can skip them by accident, but maybe we can put it more clear so you know.

THAKS FOR YOUR SUPPORT!!

notes.title: Version 1.12 is here with many improvements
notes.notes:
During this month we have been working on what may be the last patch for Oniria Crimes. The development team thanks you very much for your support, because thanks to you the game has been more polished than it was at launch. Thank you very much!

[b] Improvements in version 1.12 [/b]:
[list]
[*] Improved soundtrack. We have removed some silences between tracks, as some players thought they were bugs. We've polished track endings to improve loops, and tweaked transitions between scenes to make the listening experience that much more enjoyable.
[*] We have increased the maximum speed of the text so that it does not "kill you slowly" as some player who had never played text games believed. Now the top speed is ultra fast.
[*] A repeated phrase has been deleted at the end of case 5.
[*] We've streamlined the "Night Rounder" achievement so it's not nearly impossible to get. Now you don't have to start the game from 0 and wait for the stars to align to get it, but you can play case 6 and complete it to get it.
[*] We have fixed an issue that occurred VERY RARE where you could lose data for one game when deleting the others. We think it only happened to one player, who now hates us (just kidding). If you have lost a saved game, write to us because we can recover it.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the game from running on Mac.
[*] Fixed a UI mismatch issue on Linux.
[*] Fixed a problem with the fonts for the Chinese and Russian languages, which prevented the puzzle from case 5 from playing well. These languages ​​are very difficult to test for an indie studio. If you are playing in Chinese or Russian and see a problem with the translation or the fonts, feel free to write to us. We will fix it right away.
[/list]

How many improvements! We hope you continue to enjoy Oniria Crimes. Do not forget that it is part of a transmedia universe and that there are other games, stories, etc. Soon we will be telling you news.

notes.title: Oniria Crimes' Demo "Dreams can be Deadly"
notes.notes:
In [b]cKolmos[/b] we started in [b]1998[/b] and almost without knowing it, with the (self) publication of the [b]novel[/b] "[b]La Tasca Gris[/b]" a project that ten years later became transmedia and that leads to the publication of the video game "Oniria Crimes" this year 2020, and of which we now present its [b]demo[/b].

Nuestro juego es una aventura de investigación en un mundo distópico, con tintes noir y estética vóxel que tiene lugar en un mundo onírico, al que el ser humano ha conseguido acceder a través del método "De la Llave”. [b]Oniria Crimesl[/b] is full of characters with great personality and a very sharp sense of humor.

This [b]demo offers the first [/b] of the cases in the game, in which the [b]detectives Santos and Torres[/b] of the Rounders have just met and must [b]investigate a murder[/b]. In this world of dreams, in which not everything is what it seems, they must interrogate the objects in each room, that have a voice and opinions of their own. The observation, the resolution of complex puzzles, and the attention to detail are part of this first approach to a world with a very broad and exciting lore. The duration of the demo will depend mainly on how you approach it, it should take at least an hour.

In the game, which will be launched on October the 28th, you will find six cases in which your analysis skills, time spent, puzzle solving and way of playing will lead you to discover everything that hides the world and the characters of our particular oneiric universe.

If you want to be updated with the news and the lore of Oniria Crimes, please add it to your wishlisht and don't forget to visit the meeting point.

notes.title: Discovering Oniria Crimes Lore Vol.2
notes.notes:
Before the invention of "De la Llave Method”, achieving a lucid dream was quite complicated, but it was more challenging to have them at their own will. Few humans could visit the Land of Dreams, and even fewer could "stay" there... but there were enough of them to create the first oneiric city: The Palace of Desires. 

[h2]The Pioneers[/h2]

These early dream travelers, the true oneironauts, were considered an elite because they learned everything they knew from their own experience. The new generations, who used the "De la Llave Method”, called them the "Pioneers."

The popularization of the "De la Llave Method” caused a massive arrival of dreamers to the Land of Dreams that became known as the "Great Wave." It provoked the massification of dreams, creating problems from the oneiric society.

[h2]The Guilds of Oniria[/h2]

What at first was a "selected club of oneironauts" had become a henhouse. The Palace of Desires ceased to be a monument for meetings and became the central symbol of a great city that appeared as if from nowhere, with thousands of stands, houses, vehicles... and problems. To coordinate all the dreamers, some of the Pioneers founded the Guilds of Oniria: groups of oneironauts with common objectives. The Triple Star, the largest of these guilds, and its Leader, Tiberius, govern the Palace of Desires with an iron fist until today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38266521/211fdd8c52e93a9d7b0f7db19e9a67ecc088785f.gif[/img]

[h2]The Palace of Desires[/h2]

People had turned Oniria's heart into something like an MMO. The city, by extension, was also called the Palace of Desires, so if someone said that name, it was necessary to specify whether they meant the monument or the city.


It was a chaotic city without any foresight or urban design. Every night it could look one way or another, depending on the dreamers who came to it. It was not uncommon to see an old castle fade away and become a neighborhood of colorful houses in a matter of seconds, or the traffic on the street stop being horse-drawn carriages and become cars. The city lost its immensity on the horizon to wherever you looked.

[h2]The Grand Oniria Stadium[/h2]

However, there were permanent or quasi-permanent places. Places erected by oneironauts with the use of sand. Among them, one of the most popular was the Grand Oniria Stadium.
The Grand Oniria Stadium is a gigantic sports palace where the most popular dream sports were played and competed, such as telekinetic basketball. 
Say that many dreamers entered Oniria only to play that sport was an understatement. Players became professional, and they have created high-performance centers in Awakeland where their sleeping bodies could be attended while they trained in Oniria. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38266521/ca22e0db25fb7ce498cf1394a6f476402f51f9a2.jpg[/img]

[h2]When humans meet Kabus [/h2]

The veteran oneironauts rarely passed through the Palace of Desires and preferred to dedicate themselves to exploring and getting to know other regions of Oniria, which seemed never to end. However, nobody approached the Scorched Forest. A horrible place where most of the Kabus had retreated to: these are the natural inhabitants of Oniria, popularly known as "nightmares." 
Humans and Kabus are still getting to know each other, but most oneironauts are unaware that not all Kabus are nightmares to be feared. Kabus are seen as enemies, human ignorance was once again at work, and very few voices were raised to defend the original inhabitants of the Land of Dreams...

notes.title: Discovering Oniria Crimes Lore Vol.1
notes.notes:
[h1]The collapse of an old world [/h1] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38266521/c1e73dbb46c54a3f9dabb0376ee1c1217f4c55d8.gif[/img]

Year 2060. The melting of the ice has caused the sea level to rise and the main cities of the world are under water: New York, Buenos Aires, London, Rome, Barcelona, Cairo, Beijing, Tokyo, Sydney... are nothing but rusty [b]reminiscences[/b] alongside the fish.

Although it has not been possible to avoid this catastrophe, a technology that influences the [b]climate [/b]has been developed and has managed to paralyze the climate chain reaction by regulating the level of CO2 in the atmosphere. 

[h1] The survivors  [/h1]

The survivors of the disaster form a global mass of [b]refugees[/b] while the cities on high ground have become [b]fortresses[/b] where a semblance of normality is experienced. Refugees live in camps on the other side of city walls, or in formerly abandoned villages. Strategic points like mines and nuclear power stations are exploited by[b] private companies[/b] or protected by the army.

In the cities, the political system is a semblance of democracy, but all information is filtered by the authorized media. Global communication infrastructures have been lost, and the planet has suffered a [b]recession[/b]. The Internet is an urban network for the wealthy classes. Communication with the outside world is controlled. Old [b]religions[/b] have gained strength but new sects and heresies related to non-polluting forms of life have emerged. 

In the midst of despair,  [b]hope[/b] appears. [b]Eloy de la Llave[/b], anthropologist, and psychologist specialized in lucid dreams, discovers, and perfects a method that allows communication through sleep. 

[h1] A new way of communication  [/h1]

After the fall of the global communication networks, the method becomes popular by opening a new way of communication among dreamers, who can control what they dream and create an oneiric noosphere where they can live a second life. [u]Two realities are generated: Oniria and Awakeland.
[/u]
Most people who use the De La Llave method are refugees. Some of them have achieved a prosperous life in Oniria in exchange for spending most of their time sleeping. Only a few manage to do[b] business[/b] in both realities. 

The currency of payment in Oniria is the [b]aerena[/b], "the stuff that dreams are made of". Each person generates it naturally while sleeping, but it can be donated, spent, earned, and stolen. In addition, the rhythm at which it is generated is different in each person. [u]It is possible to "drain" the dreamers[/u]: there are mafias in Awakeland that maintain farms of sleeping people to steal it and resell it on the black market.[i][b] In this new world, dreams can be deadly…[/b][/i]
